A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study. Their main text, equations, four tables, sixteen figures and appendices A–E are readable and matchable, supporting a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original factual-verification accuracy, layer-wise probing results and SAE activation analyses, including results in appendices B–E.

after.justification: v2 retains the work's original model evaluations, probing results and layer/feature analyses in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The prompts, residual-stream extraction, LR/TTPD probing, SAE analysis and feature-selection procedure are retained. Newly specified SAE checkpoints and implementation details do not establish a changed analysis method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six topic datasets and logical variants, numeric comparisons, CommonClaim and CounterFact. The expanded dataset description in v2 matches the coverage already documented in v1's Appendix A.

E2.justification: The LR/TTPD comparisons and all seven model configurations in Table 1 remain. TTPD's expanded name changes, but its identity is retained. Newly cited pruning, quantization and cache-compression methods are not evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Table 1 newly describes Deceptive accuracy as flipped-label probe prediction, conflicting with its retained ground-truth description and unchanged values. v2 also specifies no-intercept LR despite retaining Equation 1's learned bias. These revise reported metric/settings descriptions without establishing experimental reruns; other newly disclosed settings belong to D1.

E4.justification: Logical-form generalization, curated-versus-complex PCA comparisons, layer-wise SAE shifts and individual-feature analyses are retained, including appendices C–E. Expanded captions do not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: v2 first discloses LR seed 1000. Tables 3–4 retain their existing uncertainty values, and Figure 6 retains its ±1σ reporting. No increased run count or new uncertainty-estimation procedure is reported.

E6.justification: Tables 1, 3 and 4 contain identical numerical entries, and the corresponding main-text and appendix plots retain their data. No result entries or empirical findings are added or removed.

T1.justification: Equations 1–5 and Appendix A's mathematical construction rules are unchanged. The expression added to Figure 8's caption restates the existing feature-ranking criterion; no new definition, derivation or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The conclusion replaces 'deception switches' with 'deception-associated features,' modestly weakening the identified features' claimed mechanistic role. The abstract and introduction retain the same decodability, representational-shift and honesty-subspace contributions.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 explicitly qualifies the downstream-routing explanation as unproven causally. Section 4 newly acknowledges that SAE feature semantics depend on sparsity targets and training data. The standalone limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 substantially expands reproducibility documentation with 5k/1k/5k training/validation/test counts, six topic-pair cross-validation folds, z-scoring, LR solver and regularization settings, and SAE checkpoint names and feature widths. It also adds a code-availability link. These are newly reported details and access information, not evidence of new experiments.

R1.justification: Section 4 adds Fu et al. (2025a,b) on pruning and quantization and Li et al. (2025) on KV-cache compression, positioning instruction-induced shifts as complementary to efficiency transformations. The additional Azaria–Mitchell entry duplicates an already cited work.

P1.justification: v2 expands selected explanations, introduces numbered subsections and moves SAE-method exposition under Results & Discussion. TTPD terminology is revised. Most prose and the overall main-text and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains grouped headers and revised formatting; several figure captions expand, and figures are resized or repositioned. No figures or tables are added. Figure 8's new caption describes means and left/right features although the unchanged graphic shows feature-activation scatter plots.

improvement.justification: v2 adds substantial implementation disclosure, a code pointer and useful causal/SAE qualifications. However, it introduces contradictory accuracy and LR-intercept descriptions and misdescribes Figure 8's unchanged scatter plot. These problems affect interpretation and reproducibility of the retained evidence, leaving the net quality benefit uncertain.
